title: Waste receptors.
officialText:
Every waste receptor shall be of an approved type. A removable strainer or basket shall cover the waste outlet of
waste receptors. Waste receptors shall be installed in ventilated spaces. Waste receptors shall not be installed in bathrooms or toilet rooms or
in any inaccessible or unventilated space such as a closet or storeroom. Ready access shall be provided to waste receptors.
